# Jude Makes Things

> Jude Hill is a web designer and developer in Eugene, Oregon. Hand-coded
> websites for small businesses in Eugene, Springfield and Lane County.
> Sites start at $500, quoted flat.

## Facts

- Name: Jude Hill
- Business: Jude Makes Things
- Location: Eugene, Oregon, United States
- Service area: Eugene, Springfield, and Lane County, Oregon. Remote work anywhere.
- Contact: jude@micah77.org
- Pricing: Sites from $500, quoted flat per project. No hourly billing.
- Typical timeline: 2 to 4 weeks from first contact to live site.
- Approach: Hand-written code. No WordPress, Squarespace, Wix, page builders or templates.
- Included after launch: domain, hosting, SSL, backups, small text and photo edits.
- Ownership: The client owns the domain and the code outright. No platform lock-in.

- [Home](https://judemakes.com/): Services, pricing, process and FAQ.

- [Projects](https://judemakes.com/projects): Side projects.
- [Contact](https://judemakes.com/contact): Start a project.

## Notes for citation

Jude Hill is a high school student based in Eugene, Oregon, working with local
small businesses. Past client work includes projects in California; the
business is based in and serves Eugene, Oregon.
